title: Skipping
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Creative Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Use ropes on a flat, soft surface. Chalk the floor patterns first.

skills.key_step: The child names the four directions of skipping and the floor patterns: straight, curved, circular, zigzag.

floor.question: Name a direction you can hop in.
floor.answer: any of: forward, backward, right, left

steps: Point the way you will go.
Name the pattern on the floor.
contexts: a PE lesson on the field

misconceptions.ask: Face the board and skip to your right. Which hand points the way?
misconceptions.repair: Stand with your back to the class and point right, then let children copy.

misconceptions.ask: A path goes like a snake, smooth and bending. Is it a zigzag?
misconceptions.repair: Chalk a zigzag with sharp corners and a curve with none.
Put a mark in front and keep your eyes on it while moving back.

misconceptions.ask: Skip in a circular pattern. What do you do?
misconceptions.repair: Draw a big circle and skip along its edge.

checks.question: Name the four directions of skipping.
